r2_definition: Mean window R2: compute standard 1-SSE/SST separately for each forecast window, centering on that window's actual future target mean; arithmetic mean of valid window scores within each battery/seed/phase, then equal seed and battery weights. Negative values are retained; constant windows or horizons shorter than 2 return NaN. No pooled/global or within-variance-weighted R2. R2 is a reporting metric only; checkpoint selection remains unchanged.
method: Original RMSE rechecked against raw sample arrays; R2 computed from the same arrays.
